1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Durable Objects as a stateful compute unit for AI agents — addressable, long-running, persistent, hibernating — turns out to be the right architectural primitive for agent workloads at scale.

2.title: She built a Claude shopping assistant to stop buying cheap junk
2.author: How I AI
2.hook: Using Claude with persistent project context (instructions + memory) to automate decision-making on high-judgment purchases — delegating the research layer while keeping the judgment call human.

3.title: Why this ex-Meta L8 engineer stopped reviewing his own code
3.author: Peter Yang
3.hook: Peter Yang built "No Mistakes" — an agent-based code review tool trained via parallel testing (human review vs. agent review) until agent performance matched his own catch rate, eliminating the bottleneck of manual review.
